prompt:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the OPTION orb — a small glowing plasma orb of guard energy that trails a fighter.

Design identity to keep exactly — Small glowing plasma orb with a hot orange core, a bright red-orange shell of rolling energy, a dark crimson rim, a tiny pale-yellow specular glint upper-left and a faint ring of tiny sparks; redesigned with visible energy seams in the shell so it reads as guard tech, with a compact core and rim-weighted shell.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 square cells laid out as 2 ROWS OF 2 (2-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = pulse low — small core, rolling shell dim The subject lies within aspect 0.78:1 to 1.28:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 2 = pulse high — hot core swollen, bright shell The subject lies within aspect 0.78:1 to 1.28:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 3 = shell roll A — rolling energy shifted upper-left The subject lies within aspect 0.78:1 to 1.28:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 4 = shell roll B — rolling energy shifted lower-right The subject lies within aspect 0.78:1 to 1.28:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 40 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
